name: C07 signal catch named by an expression

scenarios.name: an external signal with the evaluated name passes the catch; the receive task keeps waiting
ENGINE BUG pinned: the catch's subscription survives, so a second signal skips the receive task
scenarios.description: IntermediateCatchSignalEventActivityBehavior deletes the subscription by comparing the event name with signalRef, which is null for signalExpression; the second broadcast triggers the execution now waiting at the receive task (engine finding 29). If this scenario starts failing on a newer Activiti, the bug was fixed: expect the receive task to keep waiting.
